lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai.
Chitthi aayi hai, watan se chitthi aayi hai.
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter from home.

lines: Bade dinon ke baad hum bewatanon ko yaad,
Bade dinon ke baad hum bewatanon ko yaad, watan ki mitti aayi hai.
couplets.en: After so long away, we remember the soil of home.

lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai.
Chitthi aayi hai, watan se chitthi aayi hai.
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter from home.

lines: Upar mera naam likha hai,
Andar ye paigham likha hai.
couplets.en: My name is on the envelope, and this is what the letter says.

lines: O pardes ko jaane wale,
Laut ke phir na aane wale.
couplets.en: You who left for a foreign land and never came back.

lines: Saat samandar paar gaya tu,
Humko zinda maar gaya tu.
couplets.en: You crossed seven seas and left us scarcely alive.

lines: Khoon ke rishte tod gaya tu,
Aankh mein aansoo chhod gaya tu.
couplets.en: You broke the ties of blood and left us in tears.

lines: Kam khaate hain, kam sote hain,
Bahut zyada hum rote hain.
couplets.en: We eat little, sleep little, and weep so much.

lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai.
Chitthi aayi hai, watan se chitthi aayi hai.
couplets.en: A letter has come, a letter from home.

lines: Sooni ho gayi shehar ki galiyan,
Kaante ban gayin baagh ki kaliyan.
couplets.en: The streets have emptied, and the buds in the garden have turned to thorns.

lines: Kehte hain Saawan ke jhoole,
Bhool gaya tu, hum nahin bhoole.
couplets.en: The monsoon swings say you forgot, and they still remember.

lines: Tere bin jab aayi Diwali,
Deep nahin, dil jale hain khaali.
couplets.en: When Diwali came without you, only our hearts burned.

lines: Tere bin jab aayi Holi,
Pichkaari se chhooti goli.
couplets.en: When Holi came without you, even the water pistol felt like a gun.

lines: Peepal soona, panghat soona,
Ghar shamshaan ka bana namoona.
couplets.en: The peepal tree and the well are deserted, and the house is still as a cremation ground.

lines: Fasal kati, aayi Baisakhi,
Tera aana reh gaya baaqi, chitthi aayi hai.
couplets.en: The harvest is in and Baisakhi has come, and still we wait for you as a letter arrives.

lines: Pehle jab tu gaya tha, bhaiya, jab baithi behna,
Rasta dekh rahe the naina.
couplets.en: When you first left, brother, your sister sat with her eyes on the road.

lines: Main to baap hoon, mera kya hai,
Teri maa ka haal bura hai.
couplets.en: As for me, I am your father, but your mother is taking it hard.

lines: Teri biwi karti hai sewa,
Soorat se lagti hai bewa.
couplets.en: Your wife looks after us, though she has the face of a widow.

lines: Tune paisa bahut kamaya,
Is paise ne des chhudaya.
couplets.en: You earned a great deal, and that money took you away from home.

lines: Des paraya chhod ke aaja,
Panchhi, pinjra tod ke aaja.
couplets.en: Leave that foreign land, little bird, break your cage and come home.

lines: Des paraya chhod ke aaja,
Panchhi, pinjra tod ke aaja, aaja.
couplets.en: Leave that foreign land, little bird, break your cage and come home, come home.

lines: Umr bahut hai chhoti,
Apne ghar mein bhi hai roti.
couplets.en: Life is short, and there is bread at home too.

lines: Chitthi aayi hai, aayi hai, chitthi aayi hai.
Bade dinon ke baad hum bewatanon ko yaad watan ki mitti aayi hai.
couplets.en: A letter has come, and after so long away we remember the soil of home.
